about: The Drowned Tidevault (pack-drowned): a sea temple cut into a sea cliff, drained of its sea. Dark banded sea-rock (the Mistlands' layered rock) for walls, vaults and fills, a dark backing behind it, floors of weathered deck planking, the hulls of wrecked longships rammed through it and banded along the walls, carved ship's knees for the vault's ribs, portcullises of dark timber lattice, stone bells, kelp, cold green fire sunk in rock fonts.
